name: Logo row
oneLiner: two to four big glossy app tiles spring up one by one on the beat in the free side of the frame, under a small underlined title, with a soft floor reflection; equation mode builds 'A + B = result' term by term and slams the result
say: when the speaker names the tools they use ('I use Claude, Notion and Zapier'): each tile lands on its name; mode equation when they combine them ('Claude plus YouTube equals...'), the result slams on the payoff word
